shots.title: Sign in
shots.caption: Empty sign-in form. The card also carries the local-setup hint a developer needs on a fresh database.

shots.title: Sign in — filled
shots.caption: A correct username and password, before submission.

shots.title: Sign in — rejected
shots.caption: A failed sign-in raises a critical toast rather than an inline error. Five failures for the same user and socket peer trigger a 15-minute lockout.

shots.title: Already signed in
shots.caption: An authenticated visitor who navigates to /login is told so and offered a way forward, instead of being silently redirected.

shots.title: Register a facility
shots.caption: Tenant self-service. The endpoint is gated behind a platform secret or super_admin, so the form ships with the "disabled by default" notice.

shots.title: Register a facility — filled
shots.caption: A facility and its first admin account, with the modules that organisation would have.

shots.title: Register a facility — rejected
shots.caption: Self-serve registration is off by default, so the form explains what to do instead of showing a raw "authentication required".

shots.title: Dashboard — admin
shots.caption: Six stat cards over quick actions and recent notifications. The numbers come from /api/v1/dashboard, which is filtered by role.

shots.title: Staff roster
shots.caption: Everyone who can sign in to this hospital, each with a per-hospital role, access toggle and password state.

shots.title: Add staff
shots.caption: The temporary password is a shared secret until its owner changes it, so the form says so directly.

shots.title: Add staff — validation
shots.caption: Errors land on the control they describe and are wired with aria-invalid, not only coloured.

shots.title: Staff roster — new joiner
shots.caption: The new account is flagged "must change password" until its owner signs in and sets their own.

shots.title: Pharmacy — empty catalogue
shots.caption: A new tenant has no formulary. Note that both call-to-action buttons here are dead: the Add Medicine modal only renders once a medicine is already selected, so nothing on this screen works.

shots.title: Pharmacy — medicine selected
shots.caption: Selecting a medicine opens its batches. Nothing is received against it yet. This is also the state that makes the Add Medicine modal reachable at all.

shots.title: Receive stock
shots.caption: A stock-in is a batch with an expiry, so FEFO has something to order on.

shots.title: Pharmacy — batches
shots.caption: Expiry inside 30 days is flagged in red. Dispensing always takes the earliest expiry first, so this ordering is the FEFO order.

shots.title: Add a medicine
shots.caption: Catalogue master data. Keywords are what the AI advisor later matches a diagnosis against. Note this form only renders once a medicine is already selected.

shots.title: Dashboard — receptionist
shots.caption: The same dashboard component. What changes by role is the navigation rail and the greeting, not the layout.

shots.title: Patient list
shots.caption: Every registered patient with UHID, DPDP consent state and outstanding balance. Rows open the profile; the list is paginated.

shots.title: Register a patient
shots.caption: Name, age, phone and DPDP consent are the required minimum.

shots.title: Register a patient — filled
shots.caption: DPDP consent reveals the purpose field, so the patient can see what they agreed to.

shots.title: Patient registered
shots.caption: The toast returns the UHID, which is what the patient is called at the counter from then on.

shots.title: Dashboard — doctor
shots.caption: A clinician sees the same six counters. The rail is shorter: no staff page, no billing.

shots.title: OPD — patient picker
shots.caption: Consultation starts by picking the patient. The list is searchable and paginated so a patient registered a moment ago is reachable.

shots.title: OPD — new encounter
shots.caption: Vitals and the two free-text fields that everything downstream keys off.

shots.title: OPD — active encounter
shots.caption: The encounter is open. Prescribing and the AI advisor both work against this record.

shots.title: OPD — AI medicine advisor
shots.caption: Keyword matching against the hospital formulary. Every suggestion is one click from becoming a prescription, and shows why it matched.

shots.title: OPD — prescriptions
shots.caption: Prescriptions name the medicine and its generic, not an id. A pharmacist dispenses from this list and cannot read a UUID.

shots.title: OPD — awaiting sign-off
shots.caption: Encounters left open are held here so nothing is lost when a clinician moves on.

shots.title: OPD — signed and closed
shots.caption: Signing closes the encounter. It stops appearing in the sign-off worklist and shows as signed in the patient profile.

shots.title: IPD — ward board
shots.caption: Every bed with its occupancy, type and daily rate. Occupancy counters sit above the map.

shots.title: IPD — admit a patient
shots.caption: An available bed opens the admit dialog. Patients already admitted are not offered.

shots.title: IPD — bed occupied
shots.caption: The bed now carries the patient and the date they came in, with discharge in place.

shots.title: IPD — discharge
shots.caption: Room charges are calculated and posted to the billing ledger on discharge.

shots.title: IPD — bed released
shots.caption: Discharge frees the bed and posts the stay to billing.

shots.title: Dashboard — pharmacist
shots.caption: A pharmacist reaches pharmacy and the ledger, and nothing clinical.

shots.title: Pharmacy — pending prescriptions
shots.caption: Prescriptions waiting to be handed over, named by medicine rather than id.

shots.title: Pharmacy — dispense
shots.caption: Dispensing states the two side effects up front: FEFO deduction from the earliest batch, and a charge posted to the patient ledger.

shots.title: Pharmacy — dispensed
shots.caption: The prescription leaves the pending list and the stock movement is written to the ledger.

shots.title: Pharmacy — stock ledger
shots.caption: Every movement in and out, with the reference it belongs to. Outflows are the ones a discrepancy investigation starts from.

shots.title: Dashboard — billing
shots.caption: Billing reaches the ledger and the patient list, and nothing clinical.

shots.title: Billing — no patient selected
shots.caption: The ledger is per patient, so nothing is shown until one is chosen.

shots.title: Billing — unbilled charges
shots.caption: Pharmacy dispenses and room charges post here automatically. Nothing is typed twice.

shots.title: Billing — generate invoice
shots.caption: Selection happens through "Select All" only — the charge rows are behind the modal overlay, so a patient with mixed charge types can only be invoiced in full.

shots.title: Billing — invoice issued
shots.caption: A GST invoice is raised and the selected charges leave the unbilled list.

shots.title: Billing — record payment
shots.caption: The dialog opens pre-filled with the outstanding balance; partial payments are the normal case.

shots.title: Billing — settled
shots.caption: Settled invoices show a zero balance and no payment action.

shots.title: Patient list — after the journeys
shots.caption: Outstanding balances are populated by the pharmacy dispense and the IPD stay above.

shots.title: Patient profile — encounters
shots.caption: One view of the patient: consent state, outstanding balance, and their visit history.

shots.title: Patient profile — invoices
shots.caption: The same invoice ledger billing works from, read-only here.

shots.title: Patient profile — history
shots.caption: A tab that says it is not built yet, rather than rendering an empty table that reads as "no history".

shots.title: Patients — no search results
shots.caption: A search that matched nothing says so plainly.

shots.title: Patients — server failure
shots.caption: A server fault is reported as a server fault. Reporting it as "no patients found" would tell a clinician the record does not exist.

shots.title: Access control — doctor opening /staff
shots.caption: A doctor who types the staff URL is sent to their dashboard. The page never renders, so nothing leaks before the redirect.

shots.title: Unknown route
shots.caption: An unrecognised path is caught by the router and sent home rather than rendering a blank page.

shots.title: Navigation rail — admin
shots.caption: Admin — every module, including staff.

shots.title: Navigation rail — doctor
shots.caption: Doctor — clinical modules only. No staff, no billing.

shots.title: Navigation rail — nurse
shots.caption: Nurse — patients, encounters and admissions.

shots.title: Navigation rail — receptionist
shots.caption: Receptionist — patients and appointments.

shots.title: Navigation rail — pharmacist
shots.caption: Pharmacist — pharmacy and the ledger.

shots.title: Navigation rail — billing
shots.caption: Billing — billing and patients.
